items.rule: Any public content suggesting buy/sell/hold or portfolio composition may be an investment recommendation; must then state author name and role, date and time, keep facts objective, cite sources, disclose conflicts inside the content
items.fines: EUR 500k natural / 1m legal persons (MAR); ČNB: up to 15 / 30 mil. Kč

items.rule: Investment advice = individualised recommendation to a client on a specific instrument (§2(1)(f)); needs ČNB licence (§4(2)(e), §4a); a recommendation issued solely to the public is not personal unless presented as suitable for the reader
items.avoid: quizzes or e-mails saying 'best ETF for you'

items.rule: 'zprostředkování obchodů' (§2(1)(y)) incl. offering the opportunity to obtain an investment service on the provider's behalf counts as reception and transmission of orders (§4(4)) and needs a licence

items.rule: Foreign fund investments may be publicly offered in CZ only if the fund is on the ČNB list (§295a(1)); own-initiative purchases are not offering (§295)
items.implication: NYSE ETFs as educational benchmark only, no buy CTA

items.rule: Not the most prominent feature; 5 years or since launch, complete 12-month periods; period and source; prominent warning; currency + FX warning; fees if gross; future performance: reasonable assumptions and scenarios; tax caveat (44(7)); no regulator name (44(8))
Statement 'Past performance does not predict future returns' before data; 10y for funds with a KIID, 5y for others; annual figures alongside cumulative; risks in at least the main font size
Send the requested PDF under GDPR art. 6(1)(b); do not make it conditional on newsletter consent (art. 7(4), EDPB 05/2020 paras 25-41)

Prior consent (§7(2)); sender bears burden of proof; ÚOOÚ recommends confirmation e-mail (double opt-in, FAQ Q15); label as commercial, identify sender, unsubscribe in every message (§7(4)); customer exception (§7(3)) only for own similar products
Prior provable consent for non-essential cookies/pixels (127/2005 §89(3), opt-in since 1 Jan 2022); reject and accept in the same first layer; footer re-open link; Czech language
Self-host fonts; LG München I 20.1.2022 3 O 17493/20 awarded EUR 100 for Google Fonts CDN IP transfer without consent; no ÚOOÚ position found
Name, registered seat, register entry and IČO on the website (OZ §435(1)); Google also requires physical address and all fees visible on the landing page
